notes: All 15 IRS groups in this batch were checked. Verdicts: 9 publish (3 with a summary and status probably_active: Wesley Proctor Ministries, Widows Mite, Blessings Across Borders; 6 unknown and held back: US Federated Foundation, We Never Say Never Association, Womxn Beyond Borders, Grace Canopy Ministries, GW 78 Cares, Queen Mary Ministry USA), 4 out_of_area (BrightAid Foundation, Dialogue Center for Resilience and Empowerment, Liberia Education Project, Prayers Unite the World), 1 not_a_group (Mini Montessori Academy), 1 hide private (Greenberg Home and School Association). Budget: both WebSearch calls used, which hit the cap; 23 fetches used. Unresolvable domains: usfederateddevco.com, gw78cares.com, queenmaryministyusa.org (a corrected spelling also failed). The We Never Say Never domain redirects to an unrelated piano business. Womxn Beyond Borders returned empty pages on all three tries. BrightAid returned only its page title, so its verdict is thin. No 403s, bot checks or rate limiting were seen. Owner decision worth a look: single-school parent associations are hidden under the booster-club rule in the brief.
